specs.Supported Application: Bluetooth Calling, Fitness Tracker, GPS, Heart Rate Monitor, Messages, Sleep Monitor

features: Turn-By-Turn Navigation with MapMyIndia: Whether it’s a new destination or a familiar place, find your way without being lost using the boAt Lunar Discovery Smartwatch. Access directions using Turn-by-Turn navigation by MapMyIndia without reaching for your phone.

HD Display: Check the time, navigation routes, activity records, and more on the 1.39” (3.53 cm) TFT display. Designed with 240x240p resolution for high clarity, this watch makes it easy to view details round-the-clock.
DIY Watch Face Studio: Flaunt your vibe with personalized watch faces using the DIY Watch Face Studio of Lunar Discovery. Use your favorite themes, photos, etc., and create watch faces you like.

Bluetooth Calling: Swiftly call your frequently contacted numbers from this watch. Save up to 20 contacts for easy access or use the inbuilt dialpad to dial any phone number. Get up to 7 days of performance without Bluetooth calls and up to 4 days of use with Bluetooth calling.

IP67 Dust, Sweat & Splash Resistance: Step out for jogging in light rain, exercise at the gym, or lounge by the poolside wearing Lunar Discovery. Boasting IP67 resistance, this watch lends worry-free usage.
